card.title: SINCERELY YOURS
card.text: Give your HQ +6 defense. Draw 2 cards.
card.flavorText: During WWII, Vera Lynn was one of the most popular singers in the UK, and her music played an important role in boosting the morale of British troops fighting overseas. Lynn's songs were broadcast on the radio and played at military bases, giving soldiers a sense of comfort and home. In 1941 she became widely popular because of her weekly 30 minute radio programme called “Sincerely Yours”, described as “to the men of the forces – a letter in words and Music”. Some of her most famous songs from this time include "We'll Meet Again" and "The White Cliffs of Dover". In addition to her music, Lynn also visited military hospitals and entertained wounded soldiers, becoming a familiar face to those fighting on the frontlines. She also toured extensively, performing for troops in various locations, including Egypt, India, and Burma. Lynn's work during the war made her a beloved figure in the UK and earned her numerous accolades. She was awarded the Officer of the Order of the British Empire (OBE) in 1969 and the Order of the Companions of Honour in 2016.
